exception.justification: Justified: This pre-installation selector emits only a direct usage record and cannot instrument itself.

review.body: { if observation :: BuildKind :: compiled () != observation :: BuildKind :: Debug { return None ; } match std :: env :: var_os ("PN_DEBUG_VERSION_DISABLE") { None => Some (VersionQuerySwitch :: On) , Some (value) if value == OsStr :: new ("1") => Some (VersionQuerySwitch :: SwitchedOff) , Some (_) => { let mut record = ControlPlaneRecord :: usage_error (command_name , "version_query_configuration") ; record . message = "PN_DEBUG_VERSION_DISABLE accepts only 1 when present" . to_string () ; let _ignored = emit_control_plane_record (& record) ; exit_with (CommandExit :: Usage) ; } } }
review.item_premise: The pre-installation selector reads the debug-only setting and delivers a direct usage refusal; accepted state is recorded by the warning under the existing command root.
